mapper.select: select context_max_byte as contextMaxByte, context_usage_byte as contextUsageByte from chat_context where chat_id = #{chatId}
mapper.insert: insert into chat_context ( chat_id, context_max_byte, context_usage_byte, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time ) values ( #{chatId}, #{contextMaxByte}, #{contextUsageByte}, #{createdBy}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedTime} )
mapper.update: update chat_context set context_max_byte = #{contextMaxByte}, context_usage_byte = #{contextUsageByte}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_time = #{updatedTime} where chat_id = #{chatId}
